extDescription.message: Detects when a specific streamer goes live and switches to their channel automatically; when offline, watches a channel with Drops enabled in a chosen game category instead, otherwise stays idle; also auto-claims Drops rewards.

guideStep1.message: In "Settings", fill in the "Target Streamer" and "Category Slug" with the streamer and game category you want (the category slug is the part after twitch.tv/directory/category/ in the URL), then click "Save Settings".

guideStep2.message: Click the button at the top to enable/disable the tool; once enabled it will automatically switch you to the right channel.

guideStep3.message: Drops and Channel Points rewards are claimed automatically in the background — no need to click anything manually.

guideStep4.message: If the player freezes or errors out, it's detected automatically and the tab is reloaded for you.

guideStep5.message: If you don't want desktop notifications, turn them off in the "Desktop Notifications" section.

guideStep6.message: If the text is too small, adjust it with the "Text Size" dropdown at the top.

enableNotificationsHint.message: Notifies on switches, claims, errors (applies instantly); auto-reloads are silent

dropsRecheckIntervalHint.message: How often to re-verify Drops is still enabled while the fallback channel is still live

adoptExistingTabHint.message: Avoids opening a duplicate new tab

claimChannelPointsHint.message: Claimed directly via private API, not simulated clicks
